package db

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestTodoToJson(t *testing.T) {
	t := &Todo{
		ID:        1,
		Title:    "Test Title",
		Completed: true,
		CreatedAt: time.Time{},
		UpdatedAt: time.Time{},
	}
	json, err := t.ToJSON()
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	var result Todo
	err = json.Unmarshal(json, &result)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.EqualValues(t, t, result)
}
